units.source_text: 大厅四周镶着玻璃，呈圆形从本馆伸向庭院，像个眺望室或日光室。

en.t: The great hall was glassed in on all sides and projected in a curve from the main building toward the garden, like an observation room or a sunroom.

units.source_text: 从那里可以看见铺满草坪的宽阔庭院的两侧，那儿有两个高尔夫球场，一是富士球场，一是大岛球场。

en.t: From there one could see both sides of the broad lawn-covered garden, where there were two golf courses, the Fuji Course and the Oshima Course.

units.source_text: 庭院和高尔夫球场前边就是海。

en.t: Beyond the garden and the golf courses lay the sea.
